nodes.notes: Chạy n8n/sql/schema.sql trước để tạo bảng email_triage.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO email_triage
    (message_id, thread_id, sender, subject, received_at, link, summary, priority, category, todo)
VALUES
    ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::timestamptz, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO UPDATE SET
    summary  = EXCLUDED.summary,
    priority = EXCLUDED.priority,
    category = EXCLUDED.category,
    todo     = EXCLUDED.todo;
